text: Where do I even begin with Heather?!? Having her at my wedding was more magical than I could have ever imagined!! She was soo sweet to all my guests and made everyone feel so included while she painted everyone, and didn’t mind the one million questions from everyone! I will forever recommend her and live paintings to any friends and family getting married! This was hands down one of the best parts of the whole wedding and was something I didn’t know I always NEEDED! I cannot wait to hang her work so proudly in my home for all the years to come. Any bride/groom, wedding planner, or family member looking for a special addition to the big day, seriously needs to contact Heather!!!! I am beyond grateful to have met her and had the opportunity to share my special day with her!! 100000/10 for sure!!

owner_reply.text: GIRL!!!!! I have never seen flowers like the flowers at your wedding! It was such a HUGE honor to get to paint such a beautiful wedding! Thank you for allowing me to be a part of your day!
